subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should this issue close as already implemented/low-impact after the open fork PR is resolved, or should maintainers keep it as the canonical deep-route/static-public-asset requirement?
rationale: Current source and release evidence cover the original logo/favicon symptom, but the discussion also raises broader deep-route behavior and an open conflicting fork PR still claims to fix this issue.

options.title: Resolve PR, then close as implemented
options.body: Close or supersede the stale fork PR, then close this issue if a current packaged Control UI smoke does not reproduce the missing logo/favicon.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow route-asset fix
options.body: Keep this issue canonical only if maintainers want a specific deep-route/static-public-asset contract beyond the current root/basePath behavior.

options.title: Keep waiting for live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open until someone provides fresh browser proof on current main or the latest release.

recommendation.title: Resolve PR, then close as implemented
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale fork PR, then close this issue if a current packaged Control UI smoke does not reproduce the missing logo/favicon.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is tied to the latest release provenance and prior Control UI logo fallback work, so he is the best available routing owner for the close-versus-sponsor decision.
